topic: Foam rolling vs massage: do you need both?

slides.headline: Foam roller or massage? Maybe both
slides.sub: What each one does well and how to use them together.

slides.title: What foam rolling does well
slides.body: It's quick, cheap and you can do it daily. Many people find a few minutes of rolling helps them feel looser before training or after a long day at the desk.

slides.title: What massage adds
slides.body: A remedial massage therapist can assess and target specific areas, adjust pressure as they go, and reach spots that are hard to roll, like the neck and between the shoulder blades.

slides.title: Myth: roll until it hurts
slides.body: Rolling harder isn't more helpful. Aim for firm but comfortable pressure, about 30 to 60 seconds per area, and breathe slowly. Skip bony spots and go gently around the lower back.

slides.title: Neither replaces exercise
slides.body: Both can help you feel looser for a while, but strength work, mobility and gradual training are what build your body's capacity over time. Think of them as helpful add-ons.

slides.title: A simple way to combine them
slides.body: Roll briefly most days, especially calves, quads and upper back. Book a massage when an area keeps tightening up or you're in a heavy training block, and mention your routine.

slides.headline: Want a hands-on reset?
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists can show you where to roll at home and work alongside our physios if you're also doing rehab. Book online — link in bio.

caption:
Foam roller or massage? For most people, the answer is a bit of both.

Rolling is quick, cheap and easy to do daily. A remedial massage therapist can assess, target specific areas, adjust pressure and reach spots that are hard to roll, like the neck and between the shoulder blades.

Rolling harder isn't more helpful: aim for firm but comfortable pressure for 30 to 60 seconds per area. And remember neither replaces exercise. Strength, mobility and gradual training build capacity; rolling and massage are helpful add-ons.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy can show you where to roll at home. Book online via the link in bio.

story.headline: Roller or massage?
story.body: Roll briefly most days. Book a massage when an area keeps tightening up. Keep exercising either way.
